topPlaces.name: Gomukhi Dam & Reservoir
topPlaces.distance: 16 km from Our Lady of Rosary Church, Kallakurichi
topPlaces.description: Gomukhi Dam is a major scenic reservoir located at the foothills of the Kalvarayan Hills near Kallakurichi. It offers picturesque views of misty mountain ranges, serene water expanse, and landscaped gardens ideal for picnics and nature walks.
topPlaces.travelTime: 25–35 mins drive from Our Lady of Rosary Church, Kallakurichi

topPlaces.name: Kalvarayan Hills
topPlaces.distance: 24 km from Our Lady of Rosary Church, Kallakurichi
topPlaces.description: The Kalvarayan Hills are a major range of hills situated in the Eastern Ghats near Kallakurichi. Known for evergreen forests, cool altitude climate, tribal settlements, and cascading mountain streams.
topPlaces.travelTime: 40–55 mins drive from Our Lady of Rosary Church, Kallakurichi

topPlaces.name: Periyar Falls
topPlaces.distance: 28 km from Our Lady of Rosary Church, Kallakurichi
topPlaces.description: Periyar Falls is a popular seasonal waterfall nestled within the dense Kalvarayan hill range. The crystal-clear waters cascade down natural rocky terraces, drawing travelers for refreshing dips and nature photography.
topPlaces.travelTime: 45–60 mins drive from Our Lady of Rosary Church, Kallakurichi

image.alt: Periyar Falls cascading waters in Kalvarayan Hills

topPlaces.name: Somanatheeswarar Temple, Somandargudi
topPlaces.distance: 6 km from Our Lady of Rosary Church, Kallakurichi
topPlaces.description: An ancient temple dedicated to Lord Shiva situated on the northern bank of the Gomuki River in Somandargudi village. Features historic granite mandapam, carved pillars, and tranquil riverfront atmosphere.
topPlaces.travelTime: 10–15 mins drive from Our Lady of Rosary Church, Kallakurichi

items.note: Viluppuram Bus Station, popularly known as Villupuram New Bus Stand, is one of the bus terminus of Viluppuram, the other being the Viluppuram Old Bus Stand that is primarily used for intra-city buses. The bus station is located 2 kilometres (1.2 mi) away from the town's major railhead Viluppuram Junction.
Kallakurichi division is a revenue division in the Kallakurichi district of Tamil Nadu, India.
The Kallakurichi block is a revenue block in the Kallakurichi district of Tamil Nadu, India. It has a total of 46 panchayat villages.
Kallakurichi taluk is a taluk of Kallakurichi district of the Indian state of Tamil Nadu. The headquarters of the taluk is the town of Kallakurichi.

Kallakurichi is a first-grade municipality and the administrative headquarters of Kallakurichi district in Tamil Nadu, India. The district was formed as the 33rd district of Tamil Nadu by bifurcating Villupuram district on 8 January 2019.

The 2024 Tamil Nadu alcohol poisoning took place in Kallakurichi district in the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu on 20 June 2024. Consumption of illegally made liquor resulted in at least 65 deaths and more than 200 injuries.
Somandargudi is a village in Kallakurichi district in the state of Tamil Nadu, India. It is located on the north bank of the river Gomuki, It is 6 km away from Kallakurichi, in Sankarapuram Taluk.
Thachur is a village in Kallakurichi district in the state of Tamil Nadu, India. It is a Grama Panchayat consisting of few villages.
